input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: § 2.1 imposes a multi-year (three-year) USD 2,000,000 per year take-or-pay commitment on us expressly "without reduction or termination rights" — squarely the playbook's walk-away position and well short of the fallback (single 12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up rather than penalty). It also directly contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment, and sits oddly with § 7.1's bar on undisclosed minimum-use charges. Because the deal is structured around committed spend, we narrowed to the fallback with a minimal edit (12-month term only, 30 days' notice reduction/termination, true-up with no penalty) rather than deleting the commitment outright, while offering deletion as the preferred alternative.

proposal.summary: Narrow the three-year take-or-pay to a single 12-month commitment that is reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up instead of a penalty.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a three-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right, and it contradicts § 12.3's acknowledgement that we have given no minimum-volume commitment. We have narrowed the commitment to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up rather than a shortfall penalty; alternatively we are happy to delete § 2.1 and pay for Services used or ordered.

ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services during the current twelve-month term only, and no commitment applies to any subsequent term unless the parties agree otherwise in writing. Customer may reduce or terminate the commitment on 30 days' written notice. If Services ordered in the applicable twelve-month term are less than the committed amount, Customer's sole obligation is to pay a true-up equal to the difference between the committed amount (as reduced) and the Fees for Services ordered, and no penalty, liquidated damages, or accelerated Fees apply.
